userInputText: Manage your virtual farm in Farm Family, grow crops, and raise animals to build a thriving agricultural empire. Experience the joys and challenges!Farm Family will take you closer to your dream of building your own agricultural empire right on your personal computer. There is no need to prepare any complicated skills because, in this virtual world, you can do everything you want. This farming game will immerse you in farm experiences through a series of exciting activities. Besides, you can also perform simple tasks to upgrade and develop your small farm.A Guide to PlayTo start the endless experience in Farm Family, first of all, you need to use the given amount of money to open plots of land. This range will be used to grow staple foods such as rice and corn to gain money. From the money you earn, you can continue to explore other areas such as growing fruit, taking care of flowers, raising animals, and more.Even though there are a lot of small tasks to perform, you just need to use the mouse to do everything. The operations are extremely simple, allowing all types of players to get used to this command key in a few tries.To Become a Good FarmerPay attention to the completion time of crops or animal sources to harvest as quickly as possible.Expand the farm as soon as possible to increase production of more types of items.Plant and raise a variety of species, focusing on profitable raw materials.Similar Farming GamesGoodgame Big FarmMerge HarvestStardew Valley
